The following work has been completed:

* [R1] The public names exposed by the humanize library have been updated to meet the specified requirements.
* [R2] The naturaldelta and precisedelta functions have been updated to support years in their output and ensure they correctly handle year-level precision.
* [R3] The naturaldelta and naturaltime functions have been updated to handle very large time deltas without overflow issues.
* [R4] The public names with correct type hints have been applied: Unit, activate, apnumber, clamp, deactivate, fractional, get_translation, intcomma, intword, naturaldate, naturalday, naturaldelta, naturalsize, naturaltime, ordinal, precisedelta, scientific.
* [R5] The metric function has been added to handle SI unit formatting with specific spacing rules.
* [R6] The intcomma function has been updated to correctly handle the ndigits parameter when set to 0, ensuring proper formatting without decimal places.

The following work is still pending:

* Fixing the indentation error in the src/humanize/number.py file, which is causing the tests to fail. I have attempted to fix this error multiple times, but the tests continue to fail due to these issues. I need to resolve these indentation errors to ensure that the tests pass and the changes are verified. This is the only pending task, and it is crucial to complete it to ensure that the library functions as expected.

I am not waiting for anything external. The issue is with the indentation error in the src/humanize/number.py file, and I will continue to work on fixing it.
